mapper.select: SELECT permission.code FROM iam_tenant_permission_entitlement entitlement JOIN iam_permission permission ON permission.id = entitlement.permission_id WHERE entitlement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND entitlement.deleted_at IS NULL AND entitlement.is_enabled = true AND permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.is_enabled = true ORDER BY permission.code

WITH latest_bootstrap_template AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (event.tenant_id) event.tenant_id, NULLIF(event.payload ->> 'iamInitTemplateCode', '') AS init_template_code FROM iam_outbox_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'IamTenantBootstrapped' AND event.tenant_id > 0 AND jsonb_exists(event.payload, 'iamInitTemplateCode') ORDER BY event.tenant_id, event.updated_at DESC, event.created_at DESC, event.id DESC ), candidate_tenant AS ( SELECT binding.tenant_id FROM iam_tenant_init_template_binding binding WHERE binding.init_template_code = #{initTemplateCode} AND binding.deleted_at IS NULL AND binding.is_enabled = true UNION SELECT latest_bootstrap_template.tenant_id FROM latest_bootstrap_template WHERE latest_bootstrap_template.init_template_code = #{initTemplateCode} UNION SELECT entitlement.tenant_id FROM iam_tenant_permission_entitlement entitlement WHERE entitlement.init_template_code = #{initTemplateCode} AND entitlement.deleted_at IS NULL AND entitlement.is_enabled = true ) SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM candidate_tenant ORDER BY tenant_id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_tenant_permission_entitlement SET deleted_by = #{operator}, delete_reason = 'tenant permission entitlement replaced', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_tenant_init_template_binding ( tenant_id, init_template_code, last_entitlement_version, is_enabled, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{initTemplateCode}, #{entitlementVersion}, true, #{operator}, #{operator} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET init_template_code = EXCLUDED.init_template_code, last_entitlement_version = EXCLUDED.last_entitlement_version, is_enabled = true, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
